terms.definition: A qualification the university confers, such as a graduate certificate or a master, for a set number of credit points. When it's conferred on a learner, it's a credential too.

What the casual teaching in a teaching period costs: the claims approved for casual staff for teaching, plus on-costs, what the university pays on top of their pay. Also called sessional teaching cost, or casual teaching spend.
A student who started a course at the university for the first time in the year being counted. A student who comes back to a course they had already started, after leave or a break, isn't commencing.
A unit taught in a semester, on campus, online or both.
